name: bug
description: Something answers wrongly, throws when it shouldn't, or doesn't throw when it should

name: enhancement
description: New feature or request

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to documentation

name: tests
description: Adds or changes tests only; no production code

name: chore
description: Build, CI, packaging, refactoring with no behaviour change

name: epic
description: Tracks a release or a theme; its sub-issues are the work

name: roadmap
description: The top-level plan; its sub-issues are epics

name: area/core
description: BLEMCPCore: domain model, BLESession, write policy

name: area/corebluetooth
description: BLEMCPCoreBluetooth: the CoreBluetooth backend

name: area/replay
description: BLEMCPReplay: ReplayCentral and capture diff

name: area/server
description: BLEMCPServer: tools, schemas, stdio transport

name: area/cli
description: The ble-mcp executable: environment, signals, relaunch, diff command

name: area/capture
description: The JSONL capture format and its writers and readers

name: area/security
description: Write safety and untrusted device data

name: area/release
description: Versioning, signing, packaging and release wiring

name: severity/critical
description: Data loss, damage to a device, or silently wrong results in common use

name: severity/high
description: Wrong results, crash or failed writes in a realistic scenario

name: severity/medium
description: Inconsistency or failure in a narrow scenario

name: severity/low
description: Cosmetic, message or documentation-level difference

name: silent
description: Answers wrongly, or writes something unintended, without an error

name: breaking
description: Changes a tool, an environment variable or the capture format

name: needs-hardware
description: Can only be verified against a real peripheral

name: stacked
description: Base is another open PR; merge in order
